facts: Database name: The Study Salon. Category: hair salon. Neighborhood: Seminole Heights. City: Tampa.
Address: 4705 N Florida Ave, Tampa, FL 33603.
Website: https://thestudysalon.com/ and services page https://thestudysalon.com/services/.
Homepage: laid-back, personality-filled group of stylists specializing in custom color, extensions and precision cutting.
Homepage goal statement: good hair, honest conversations, and an experience that feels comfortable from the minute you walk in.

Homepage: they proudly use Maria Nila products. The page mentions nourishing treatments and styling essentials. It describes Maria Nila with the salon's own words: premium quality, innovative formulas, and commitment to sustainability.
Homepage offers Make a Reservation and Text Us! (813) 538-3648.
Parking is behind the building. Entrance is just around the corner.
Website hours: Sunday Upon Request, Monday Upon Request, Tuesday 10 AM - 8 PM, Wednesday 10 AM - 8 PM, Friday 10 AM - 6 PM, Saturday 8 AM - 6 PM. Thursday is not in that list.
The services page repeats the phone, address, parking note, and the same hours. It does not list individual services or prices.

Stored database hours, which conflict with the website: Sunday 9:00 to 15:00, Monday closed, Tuesday 10:00 to 18:00, Wednesday 10:00 to 18:00, Thursday 10:00 to 18:00, Friday 10:00 to 18:00, Saturday 8:00 to 18:00.
